use_https_mailto_or_a_path_beginning_wit: Use https://, mailto:, or a path beginning with one slash.
slug_format: Use Latin letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores for the URL.
meta_description_help: A short summary that may appear in search results and link previews. Aim for about 150–160 characters. It is not shown in the page body.
authors_help: Profiles of the people who write our texts.
events_help: Readings, workshops and writing groups. Preview each language before publishing.

choose_up_to_four_authors_in_display_ord: Choose up to four authors in display order.
event_cover_help: Shown at the top of the event page. Add pictures within the text in Content below.
event_registration_help: Optional link to a booking page or sign-up form. Leave empty if no registration is needed.
place_map_failed: Map unavailable. You can still search or enter coordinates.

saved_places_failed: Could not load saved locations. Try again.
place_reverse_failed: No address available. The selected coordinates are kept.
events_feature_help: Leave empty to feature the nearest upcoming event. Past events, drafts, and untranslated events are omitted.
event_title_limit: Up to 80 characters. Keep the title clear and specific.
event_description_limit: Up to 160 characters. One short sentence for the programme.
events_introduction_limit: Up to 180 characters. Introduce the programme in one or two sentences.
additional_featured_events_help: Choose up to four additional upcoming events, in display order. Past events, drafts, and duplicates are omitted.
price_help: Use a decimal point, e.g. 12.50, not 12,50.
inventory_help: Copies in stock. 0 means sold out; leave empty for no limit.
shipping_rate_help: Flat rate added once to every order. Use a decimal point, e.g. 4.50.
price_note_help: Shown below prices and at checkout, e.g. a VAT notice.
slug_reserved: The shop uses this URL. Choose another one.
slug_de_help: Used for the German website. Until the first publish it follows the German title or name; once you change it, your version is kept. Titles without Latin letters need a slug typed by hand.
slug_en_help: Used for all other languages. Leave empty to use the German slug.
slug_ascii_format: Use only lowercase Latin letters (a–z), digits (0–9) and hyphens (-).
slug_taken: Another entry already uses this URL. Choose another one.
author_name_help: Write the name once in German, in Latin script. Other languages show it until you enter a different spelling there. A pseudonym is fine.
author_name_required: Enter the name in German before publishing.
author_name_latin: Write the German name in Latin script.
snippet_help: Short excerpt for poem cards. Empty: cards show the first four lines.
poem_required_in_original: Enter this in the poem's original language before publishing.
